Squads lets you build and grow a community that's engaged and active, where developers already are. 👋 Building a developer community is tough. That’s why we built daily.dev Squads—to make it easier to create a thriving developer community from day one. With Squads, you get a head start by tapping into a global network where developers are already active. Over 1 in 50 developers worldwide start their day on daily.dev, and during our beta alone, more than 10,000 Squads were created.🤯 That shows how much people need a space like this. ## Introducing daily.dev Squads 🥁

### Major Announcement

Comp 2_2.gif

Comp 2_2.gif

## Introducing Squads!🥁

This one is BIG, and we’re going to go for it.. No holding back. It’s “EXCITING”!

## Single player -> Multiplayer 🤯

Until today, you’ve been able to enjoy daily.dev almost entirely in single-player mode: read, comment, bookmark, etc.. You know the drill. There’s discussion and feedback, but most of the time, you’re enjoying the platform on your own.

Starting today, daily.dev opens up a whole new layer of collaboration with daily.dev Squads. This is the day when we officially add a new multiplayer mode to your experience on daily.dev 👯

## What is a Squad? 🤔 [...] ## What is a Squad? 🤔

A Squad is a group where you and other developers can come together to learn and interact on topics that matter to you. You can think of Squads like any other online group but geared specifically towards developers.

On Squads, you can share knowledge, ask questions, and engage in discussions, all within a private group of your peers.

Squads can center around your team, a project, a community, or anything else. It can be about a topic, a mutual goal, or just having fun together. The possibilities are endless (but keep it clean).

## Key features of Squads 👀

Here are some of the features that are now live as part of Squads:

✨ Create a Squad: Starting today, you all have the ability to create your own Squads, complete with a unique name, image, and description.
